tasks.short: Contribute to protocols, study reports, and submissions.

steps.what: Select approved text for the clinical study reports.
Draft study reports from that approved text.

loop.purpose: Draft a study-report section from approved text only.
loop.input: Approved report text already in the trial record.
loop.output: A draft section that adds nothing.
loop.check: The data manager rejects any sentence or citation that is not in the approved text.
loop.stop: Stop when they accept or reject. The draft never files itself and never adds a reference.
loop.why_not_simpler: The approved text is prose. A field copy cannot arrange a study-report section.

steps.what: Check the reports add no outside citation.
Contribute that text to regulatory submissions.
Accept the controlled documentation.
File the accepted controlled documentation.

tasks.design: The data manager selects approved text already in the trial record. A draft study-report section is proposed from that text only. They reject any sentence or citation that was not in the source, contribute the checked text to the submission, and accept the controlled documentation. The file stores that version. It is not sent to an authority from here. The draft never adds a reference.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study-report sections are rewritten even when the approved text already exists.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can be arranged from approved text the person has selected. It cannot add a citation or file itself.
tasks.still_hard: The data manager still has to check every sentence. A submission that invents a citation is not fit to file.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager selects the approved text, rejects any new citation, and accepts the document.
tasks.altitude: Selecting the source text, checking citations, and accepting the document stay with the data manager. The file holds only that version. Another role transmits the submission.

reach.task: Transmit documentation the data manager accepted
reach.learn: The text was checked by the data manager

evidence.claim: Novo Nordisk reports that Claude drafted clinical study reports from approved text, from more than ten weeks to ten minutes, and that review cycles halved. The digest marks this as a vendor claim. This design does not use those times.
EU clinical-trial rules require verifiable records, and the master file is kept for 25 years.
EU rules have required AI literacy since February 2025 for people who use a system that drafts text. The person must be able to accept or reject the draft.
The draft uses approved text only. The person rejects any citation that was not in that text. The vendor's time figures are not used.

assumptions: The workflow starts when approved text exists and ends when the accepted documentation is on the file. The data manager checks every citation. Another role transmits any submission. The draft adds nothing.
The fields are the source text id, the draft sentence, the citation check, and their acceptance. They select the source. If the draft adds a citation, they reject it. The draft never files itself.

The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that a draft may start from approved text. They disagree by keeping the selection, the citation check, the submission judgement, and the acceptance, and by not using a vendor's time figures.
Upkeep is reviewing drafts the data manager rejects.
unknowns: Who transmits the submission to the authority.
Which text counts as already approved.
research_questions: Who transmits the submission to the authority?
Which text counts as already approved?

already_counted.description: Checking that the reports add no outside citation stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Review drafts the data manager rejects

approvals.approved_version: controlled documentation the data manager accepted after rejecting any new citation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the draft cannot be limited to approved text, it is not used, and the low end is selecting the text and checking citations, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read literature and keep current database practice.

steps.what: Read technical literature on database technology.
Participate in continuing education.
Participate in professional associations.
Note the practices they choose to maintain.

tasks.design: The data manager reads the technical literature and takes part in continuing education and professional associations. Those sessions are not recorded. They note the practices they choose to maintain. A list of titles is not a substitute for the reading, and nothing writes a review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reading is the work. A pile of unread titles does not change that.
tasks.enabler_now: A title can be listed. It does not read the paper.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining awareness stays with the data manager. A generated summary would not be the reading.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager reads, attends, and notes the practices they choose.
tasks.altitude: Reading and attendance stay with the data manager. The note is only the practices they choose. Sessions are not recorded.

reach.task: Hear a practice the data manager chose to maintain
reach.learn: The reading was the data manager's

evidence.claim: The person reads the literature and attends the sessions. A list of titles does not replace the reading, and the sessions are not recorded.

assumptions: The workflow starts when literature or a session is available and ends when the data manager has noted a practice. They do the reading. Sessions are not recorded. Nothing writes a review.
The fields are the title, the session, and the practice they choose. They produce the note. If they have not read the item, it is not noted. Nothing summarises a paper.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that the reading and the attendance stay. The note is paperwork they already do.
Upkeep is keeping the title list aligned with the note. The list does not replace the reading.
unknowns: Which associations the data manager already belongs to.
Whether education time is paid time.
research_questions: Which associations does the data manager already belong to?

already_counted.description: Reading technical literature stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the title list aligned with the note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If no title list is kept, the whole reading stays, and the low end is the reading and the attendance, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train staff on procedures and software usage.

steps.what: Train staff on technical procedures.
Train staff on software program usage.
Write which staff attended the procedures.
Accept the staff attendance note.
File the staff attendance note.

tasks.design: The data manager trains the staff on the procedures and on the program. No lesson is generated. After the training they write who attended, accept that note, and the file stores it. The training is not recorded. The note is not a score of the staff.
tasks.previous_blocker: The training is the work. Attendance is then copied into a second list.
tasks.enabler_now: An attendance note the person has accepted can be filed.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching stays with the data manager. A generated lesson is not the training.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager trains the staff and accepts the attendance note afterwards.
tasks.altitude: Training stays with the data manager. The attendance note is filed only after they accept it. No lesson is generated and no score is kept.

reach.task: Use a procedure the data manager taught
reach.learn: The training was given by the data manager

evidence.claim: Dutch works-council law requires consent before a dashboard shows an individual worker's performance. This design does not build that dashboard. Other countries set their own rules.
Teaching stays with the person. An attendance list is not a lesson and not a score of the staff.

assumptions: The workflow starts when staff need the procedure and ends when the accepted attendance note is on the file. The data manager does the teaching. No lesson is generated. The note is not a score.

The fields are the procedure, the staff name, and their acceptance of the attendance note. They write the name after the session. If someone was absent, they do not mark them present. Nothing generates a lesson.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that the teaching stays. They disagree only about filing an attendance note the data manager has already written and accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the attendance names aligned with the file.
unknowns: Whether attendance must be kept for a fixed number of years.
Whether a works council treats an attendance note as staff monitoring.
research_questions: Must attendance be kept for a fixed number of years?
Does a works council treat an attendance note as staff monitoring?

already_counted.description: Training staff on technical procedures stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the attendance names aligned with the file

approvals.approved_version: staff attendance the data manager accepted after the training

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If attendance is still kept on paper, the filing stays, and the low end is the training, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: State the research scenarios the software must serve.
Develop specific requirements for those scenarios.
Select software programs for those scenarios.
Accept the software programs they select.
File the accepted software selection.

tasks.design: The data manager states the research scenarios, develops the requirements, and selects the programs. A table can list their requirements beside what they have read. It does not score a program and it does not purchase one. They accept the selection. The file stores that version. No order is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The comparison is redone in a fresh sheet for each scenario.
tasks.enabler_now: A table can hold requirements the person has already written. It cannot select the program.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting the software stays with the data manager. A purchase is a separate decision and is not sent from here.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager states the scenarios, selects the programs, and accepts the selection.
tasks.altitude: Selecting the software stays with the data manager. The file holds the selection only after they accept it. Nothing is purchased.

reach.task: Install a program the data manager selected
reach.learn: The selection was the data manager's

evidence.claim: The person states the scenarios and selects the program. A table of their requirements is not a score and not a purchase.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a research scenario is known and ends when the accepted selection is on the file. The data manager selects the program. No order is sent.

The fields are the scenario, the requirement, the program they name, and their acceptance. They produce the selection. If a requirement is missing, they write it. Nothing scores a program and nothing purchases one.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that the selection stays. They disagree only about filing a selection they have already accepted.
Upkeep is keeping the requirement list aligned with the file.
unknowns: Whether a purchase must be raised by another role.
Which scenarios are in scope this year.
research_questions: Must a purchase be raised by another role?
Which scenarios are in scope this year?

already_counted.description: Selecting the software programs stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the requirement list aligned with the file

approvals.approved_version: software programs the data manager selected and accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the comparison must stay a blank page, the table stays unused, and the low end is stating the scenarios and selecting the programs, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

role.altitude: Study-report text is drafted only from approved source text, and the data manager rejects any new citation before they accept the document. They still read the literature, still train the staff, and still select the software. Nothing is purchased.
reach: Regulatory staff transmit documentation the data manager accepted
Technology staff install a program the data manager selected
skills_to_grow: Rejecting a citation that was not in the approved text
Training the staff rather than issuing a generated lesson
Selecting software without sending a purchase
role.ambitious_version: Every filed study-report section is one the data manager checked against approved text.
